abstract_html: '<p>A compact typed framework for reasoning about agent actions against temporal properties evaluated on finite observation prefixes. Five footprint action classes at layer L_1 - READ, THINK, SPEAK, WRITE, ACT - are given a uniform typed signature with an explicit carrier partition (transient M vs persistent P). A three-action quotient q_{5-&gt;3} identifies SPEAK, WRITE, ACT into RESPOND and is proved conservative on carrier-insensitive families (rem:a3-conservative). The principal formal result is FA-REENTRY (prop:reentry): the architectural conditions under which a WRITE followed by a delayed READ can recover the payload, delimited by the carrier-lifetime clause Delta &lt;= L_C.</p><p>A dedicated section (sec:temporal-typing) maps footprint predicates onto the Safety / Cosafety / Liveness / Coliveness intersection algebra of Bragetti-Italiano (Zenodo 10.5281/zenodo.21099448), separates the FA-REENTRY event formula (finite Cosafety, rung 3) from the architectural reentry claim, and documents an optional refinement-confirmation certification layer (Bragetti, Zenodo 10.5281/zenodo.22028019) for FG-persistence stabilisation and system-level response-mechanism convergence, with an explicit temporal-class / refinement-confirmability orthogonality witness (GF p and FG p share indicator (0,0,1,1) yet only FG is RC-confirmable).</p><p>---</p><p>TECHNICAL REPORT. Version 1. This is a technical report and has not been peer reviewed.</p><p>---</p><p>Version note (this version): this version incorporates a citation-integrity review of the manuscript. A duplicate bibliography entry for the same source was consolidated to a single entry, three cross-references to a companion paper''s results were corrected to their accurate locator numbers, and minor bibliography annotations were corrected. No change to the central scientific results is intended.</p>'
